text: Assumption: Since Result<T&, E> merely binds a reference and does not own the target object, the caller shall ensure that the referenced object exists at least as long as the Result instance — is this correct?

assumption: Since Result<T&, E> merely binds a reference and does not own the target object, the caller shall ensure that the referenced object exists at least as long as the Result instance.
rationale: The type alias value_type is defined as T& (SWS_CORE_00902) and the specification describes no dedicated memory management for the target object.

original.text: Annahme: Lebensdauer des referenzierten Objekts: Da Result<T&, E> lediglich eine Referenz bindet und das Zielobjekt nicht besitzt, dürfte der Aufrufer sicherstellen müssen, dass das referenzierte Objekt mindestens so lange existiert wie die Result-Instanz — trifft das zu?
